parties: Maskeliya Plantations PLC Vs. Minister of Tourism and Land, and Others Maskeliya Plantations PLC Vs. Minister of Tourism and Land, and Others View More
judgement_by: Hon. Dr. D. F. H. Gunawardhana, J.
keywords: The Petitioner sought to challenge the second acquisition notice and immediate possession of certain portion of land from which a previous acquisition and immediate possession had already taken place in 2016; Locus standi of the Petitioner; Application of the Land Manual; Urgency of acquisition. Held – Based on the evidence placed before Court, acquisition process initiated by the Respondents is one continuous process occurring in two stages; despite application of the Land Manual in favour of the Petitioner, urgent necessity of the land in suit takes prominence. Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
